integrity: All stated infinite-length conclusions are proved by polynomial cancellation, invertible gap transformation and Burnside orbit counting; the independent literal verifier checks finite instances only.
scientific_limitations: The inverse-fiber classification applies to binary necklaces with exactly three ones and complete multiplicity-valued rotation observations.
A previous 2002 study establishes cyclic inversion increments and modular equidistribution; these components are not claimed as new.
Earlier unindexed versions of the full spectrum-fiber result may exist; historical uniqueness is not certified.
title: Exact reconstruction fibers of cyclic two-binomial spectra at weight three
